claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall has a Cargo.lock at the release tag.
claims.limitation: Cargo.lock presence does not prove that release binaries were built from it.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall has an exact Rust toolchain pinned at the release tag.
claims.limitation: Toolchain metadata alone does not prove deterministic builds.
Pinned actions reduce drift but do not prove release asset provenance.

claims.atomic_claim: GitHub Actions runners are fully pinned and non-floating.
claims.limitation: Runner labels are only one part of build reproducibility.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall release builds are byte-identical reproducible.
claims.observed_evidence: no byte-identical rebuild performed in v0.6
claims.limitation: Requires deterministic build recipe, controlled environment and byte-level comparison.
Binary safety cannot be inferred from build metadata.
